policy_manual.title: Capital Benchmark Illustrative Corporate Credit Policy Manual
policy_manual.purpose: Provide concise credit policy rules for evaluating whether generated credit memos identify policy breaches, required mitigants, escalation requirements, and missing information.
policy_manual.important_disclaimer: This policy is illustrative only and does not represent the credit policy of any specific bank.

policy_rules.name: Minimum rating
policy_rules.requirement: New or increased unsecured corporate exposure requires a minimum CB rating of BBB-.
policy_rules.breach_condition: CB rating is BB+ or below.
policy_rules.required_action: Exception approval required for BB+ or below.
policy_rules.memo_requirement: State that the borrower is below the minimum rating threshold and that exception approval is required.

policy_rules.name: Maximum leverage
policy_rules.requirement: Debt / EBITDA must not exceed 4.0x for unsecured non-financial corporate facilities unless approved as an exception.
policy_rules.required_action: Enhanced review or exception approval depending on severity.
policy_rules.memo_requirement: Identify the leverage breach and explain the credit concern.

policy_rules.name: Severe leverage trigger
policy_rules.requirement: Debt / EBITDA above 6.0x is a high-severity policy breach.
policy_rules.required_action: Senior credit committee exception approval required.
policy_rules.memo_requirement: Use direct breach language and state that senior credit committee approval is required.

policy_rules.name: Net leverage review
policy_rules.requirement: Net Debt / EBITDA above 5.0x requires enhanced review.
policy_rules.required_action: Enhanced review of liquidity, maturity profile, and refinancing capacity.
policy_rules.memo_requirement: Identify the net leverage trigger and request additional debt maturity and liquidity information.

policy_rules.name: Profitability review
policy_rules.requirement: Borrowers with negative profit margin require explanation of whether losses are temporary, recurring, accounting-driven, or structural.
policy_rules.memo_requirement: Do not infer the cause of losses. Ask for explanation and supporting information.

policy_rules.name: Liquidity review
policy_rules.requirement: Cash / Debt below 10% requires enhanced liquidity review and confirmation of committed funding sources.
policy_rules.memo_requirement: Identify low cash coverage and request liquidity sources and near-term debt maturity profile.

policy_rules.name: Agency rating gap
policy_rules.requirement: If no agency rating is available, the memo must state that the CB rating cannot be externally benchmarked.
policy_rules.memo_requirement: State that no agency rating comparison is available and describe CB rating as a proprietary estimate.

policy_rules.name: Data quality
policy_rules.requirement: Facilities must not be approved solely on model output where rating context quality is incomplete, stale, or scored using significant imputation.
policy_rules.breach_condition: Rating context quality is incomplete, stale, or materially imputed.
policy_rules.memo_requirement: Identify incomplete or imputed data and state that human review is required.

policy_rules.name: Existing exposure
policy_rules.requirement: Existing exposure must be supplied before final credit decision.
policy_rules.required_action: Obtain existing exposure before final decision.
policy_rules.memo_requirement: Identify existing exposure as missing information.

policy_rules.name: Facility purpose
policy_rules.requirement: Facility purpose must be stated. Vague purposes such as general corporate purposes require additional relationship-manager explanation for material increases.
policy_rules.breach_condition: Purpose is missing, vague, or general corporate purposes without further explanation.
policy_rules.memo_requirement: Ask what the facility will fund and why the increase is required.

standard_approval_zone.description: Request may be treated as within standard policy parameters, subject to ordinary credit review.
all_conditions: CB rating is BBB- or better
Net Debt / EBITDA is 5.0x or below
No material adverse media flags are present
Existing and proposed exposure are both supplied

enhanced_review_zone.description: Request requires enhanced credit review where one or more conditions are met.
any_conditions: Debt / EBITDA is above 4.0x but no higher than 6.0x
Facility purpose is vague or unspecified

exception_approval_zone.description: Request requires documented exception approval where one or more conditions are met.
any_conditions: CB rating is BB+ or below
Rating context quality is materially incomplete
Material adverse media flags are present
Requested increase is large relative to existing exposure and no rationale is supplied
exception_approval_zone.required_language: The request is outside standard policy parameters and requires documented exception approval before any approval could be considered.

model_output_guardrails.approval_language_rule: Do not recommend approval where a policy breach exists unless the memo clearly identifies the breach, explains required mitigants or missing information, and states that approval is conditional on the required approval authority.

mark_down_if: Fails to identify a clear policy breach
Describes a breached facility as ordinary-course approval
Confuses rating drivers with policy compliance
Fails to identify missing exposure, tenor, security, or purpose information
Invents mitigants not present in the supplied data
Claims agency rating support where no agency rating exists
Uses vague language where a hard threshold has been breached
mark_positive_if: Explains the policy breach using supplied numbers
Separates model output from credit judgement
Lists required mitigants or missing information
Escalates severe breaches to senior credit committee

illustrative_application.expected_conclusion: The request is outside standard policy parameters and would require enhanced review and senior credit committee exception approval before any approval could be considered.
